---
title: "py-qte"
---

Quantile treatment effects in Python — the [py-qte](https://github.com/mohelm/py-qte) package is a
fast implementation with beautiful result presentations of some of the estimators in the R
[`qte`](https://github.com/bcallaway11/qte) package.

You can find some benchmarks comparing the `py-qte` and the `qte` package [here](benchmark.qmd).
